scripts.build:app:dev: rm -rf dist/app && tsc && vite build --mode development
scripts.build:manifest: rm -rf dist/package && mkdir -p dist/package/assets && cp src/manifest.json dist/package/ && cp -r src/translations dist/package/ && cp src/assets/icon.svg dist/package/assets/
scripts.build: bun run build:app && bun run build:manifest && ./scripts/inject-manifest-env.sh .env.production
scripts.build:dev: bun run build:app:dev && bun run build:manifest && ./scripts/inject-manifest-env.sh .env.development
scripts.package: bun run build:manifest && ./scripts/inject-manifest-env.sh .env.production && cd dist/package && zip -r ../userplane.zip .
scripts.package:dev: bun run build:manifest && ./scripts/inject-manifest-env.sh .env.development && cd dist/package && zip -r ../userplane.zip .
